XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Flashing/steady illumination of fault warning lights, illegible display in the instrument panel
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | WARNING LIGHTS | FLASHING | ON | STEADY | INDICATOR | DIRECTION | DASHBOARD | INSTRUMENTS | ABS | AIRBAG | BATTERY | LCD |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Instrument panel

  • Fault: When using the direction indicator, several warning lights on the instrument panel flash abnormally, usually those relating to ABS, engine management, battery and airbags, but other warning lights may also be affected. In some cases, the warning lights remain permanently lit even when the ignition is switched off. The LCD display on the instrument panel is often unreadable.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Internal malfunction of the instrument panel control board.

• Action: Check and, if necessary, replace the instrument panel

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The problem is related to an internal defect in the instrument panel control board which, due to wear or electronic faults, causes interference between the circuits, generating abnormal flashing of the warning lights when the indicator is activated or causing them to remain lit even without power. Before identifying the cause, checks were carried out on the behaviour of the warning lights and their correlation with the use of the turn signals, ruling out problems related to sensors or secondary control units.
